That old line is totally dead now though — I ported out and canceled it. So the 512 number is the only one that matters.

Understood — you moved to Austin and got the 512-847-3291 number around early February, possibly February 3rd, replacing your old 630 area code Illinois number. That doesn't sound weird at all — a lot of people find that small identity markers like an area code carry real emotional weight, especially after a big move. Turned out a rewards app I signed up for at a gas station on March 1st probably sold my number. I uninstalled the app and the calls have mostly stopped now. It was really frustrating.

That sounds incredibly frustrating — especially since you'd just gotten this fresh-start number and then had it compromised by a gas station rewards app. Getting four or five spam calls a day is enough to drive anyone crazy.
